annotations.title: Venues open at a place and time

description: Lists venues within a radius of a point that are open at the given moment (default: now). Hours are either listed or an estimate (basis=estimate).

at.description: Moment to evaluate, ISO 8601. Without an offset it is the local time of the place. Default: now.

category.description: Venue category or parent category, e.g. cafe, restaurant, pub, gym, library. See sources for the list.

city.description: City name within a covered area; used when lat/lon are not given (the part of the city with most venues is used as the centre).

include_closed.description: Also return venues that are closed at that moment. Default false.

name: open_now
title: Venues open at a place and time
